title: Sources: Alphabet plans to raise at least CA$5B in a five-part Canadian bond sale, after raising CA$8.5B in its debut Canadian offering in May (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Alphabet plans to raise at least CA$5B in a five-part Canadian bond sale, after raising CA$8.5B in its debut Canadian offering in May — Alphabet Inc. is returning to the Canadian market with a five-part bond sale, just six months after issuing its first notes in the currency.
